## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals with Industrials, Energy and Real Estate leading while Technology and Communication lag; Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given cyclical sector strength and commodity/industrial leaders.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate leads: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND but not broad enough to lift the sector. Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed-to-weak: WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND; AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND; CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND; MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND; QCOM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -9.48%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND. Watch AMZN (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +7.44%) TREND EXHAUSTION for potential short-term reversal rather than core trend change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with downside breadth. NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W performance negative and internals uneven.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak despite select leaders. BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND; WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND; JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND — breadth shows rotational activity within the group.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Choppy and defensive names catching bids. JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -0.95%) BELOW TREND; LLY (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND — sector slightly negative 1W.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclical/value exposures on present internals: Industrials (LMT, RTX, BA), Energy (XOM, CVX), and select Real Estate names (AMT, CCI). Reduce exposure to weak, high-multiple Technology and Communication names while monitoring NVDA as a single-stock leader.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (sector +3.43% 1W) and Energy (sector +1.02% 1W) on strong leaders and news flow. BEARISH: Technology (sector -2.14% 1W) and Communication (sector -3.79% 1W) as leadership narrows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND — watch for breach of the 1M uptrend to signal broader tech risk. AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND — monitor for deeper 1W weakness to confirm trend continuation. BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND — follow for sustained flows into Financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CVX (+65): Energy expansion headline; CVX (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price strength. AMD (+50): KeyBanc upgrade; AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned. MSFT (+55): Positive coverage; MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverges from price, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CCI (-55): DISH dispute headline; CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — bearish news diverges from strong price action. NVDA (-45): China memory supply concerns; NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment vs price divergence, monitor for distribution. WFC (-45): weaker bank revenue headlines; WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Industrials, Energy and Real Estate leadership and mixed breadth (6/11 sectors positive). AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND and LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: divergent news vs price (CCI, AMT, NVDA and MSFT) could trigger tactical volatility — monitor sentiment-confirmation closely.
